limitations: Native scenario run03 ended after its first sample; repeat stability was checked only in direct-world run01.
Observed initial faction is recorded per run; future faction changes and US/USSR storage have not been measured.
Random base starting targets are observations of these runs, not constants for later sessions.
Grid totals are live consumer aggregates, not the sum of map-grouped source objects.
Profiles, saves, full logs and extracted vanilla scripts are excluded from Git.
